provenance: Actual cumulative Git merge-base/head diff; baseline eligibility injected only by tests
workflowBefore:
name: P1 verification

on:
  pull_request:
  push:
    branches:
      - main
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      mode:
        description: Independent P1 or single formal PF-2 H1 (not whole PF-2/PF-3)
        type: choice
        options:
          - p1
          - pf2-h1
        default: p1
        required: true

permissions:
  contents: read

concurrency:
  group: p1-${{ github.workflow }}-${{ github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: true

jobs:
  p1:
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        mode: ${{ github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch' && inputs.mode == 'pf2-h1' && fromJSON('["pf2-h1"]') || fromJSON('["p1-checks", "p1-core", "p1-portal"]') }}
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    timeout-minutes: 45
    env:
      VERIFY_MODE: ${{ matrix.mode }}
    steps:
      - name: Checkout full clean history
        uses: actions/checkout@9c091bb21b7c1c1d1991bb908d89e4e9dddfe3e0 # v7.0.0
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0
          persist-credentials: false
          ref: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha || github.sha }}

      - name: Scope verification basis to the release ref
        run: |
          git for-each-ref --format='%(refname)' 'refs/remotes/origin/**' | grep -vx 'refs/remotes/origin/main' | xargs -r -n 1 git update-ref -d
          git remote set-url origin "https://github.com/${GITHUB_REPOSITORY}.git"
          git reflog expire --expire=now --all
          git gc --prune=now --quiet

      - name: Install pinned Node
        uses: actions/setup-node@949feb2413d6458794dcd2491c4babbbce0c15c1 # v7.1.0
        with:
          node-version: 24.16.0

      - name: Acquire exact pnpm under explicit online bootstrap policy
        env:
          npm_config_offline: "false"
          npm_config_prefer_offline: "false"
          npm_config_ignore_scripts: "true"
          npm_config_audit: "false"
          npm_config_fund: "false"
          npm_config_update_notifier: "false"
          NO_UPDATE_NOTIFIER: "1"
        run: npm install --global pnpm@11.3.0 --ignore-scripts --no-audit --no-fund --no-update-notifier --prefer-online

      - name: Verify acquired pnpm version
        run: test "$(pnpm --version)" = "11.3.0"

      - name: Acquire exact dependencies explicitly
        env:
          npm_config_offline: "false"
          npm_config_prefer_offline: "false"
          npm_config_ignore_scripts: "true"
          npm_config_audit: "false"
          npm_config_fund: "false"
          npm_config_update_notifier: "false"
          NO_UPDATE_NOTIFIER: "1"
        run: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile --ignore-scripts --config.offline=false

      - name: Acquire official pinned Corepack and its pnpm cache for manual H1
        if: github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch' && inputs.mode == 'pf2-h1'
        env:
          npm_config_offline: "false"
          npm_config_prefer_offline: "false"
          COREPACK_ENABLE_NETWORK: "1"
        run: |
          npm install --global corepack@0.34.6 --force --ignore-scripts --no-audit --no-fund --no-update-notifier --prefer-online
          test "$(corepack --version)" = "0.34.6"
          corepack install --global pnpm@11.3.0
          test "$(corepack pnpm@11.3.0 --version)" = "11.3.0"

      # Use the same complete HEAD-reachable privacy history for fork dispatch,
      # pull requests and main. A PR must not hide a failing base-history finding.
      - name: Verify P1 offline
        env:
          EINZBERN_PRIVACY_HISTORY_BASE: ""
        run: |
          root="$RUNNER_TEMP/einzbern-p1-${GITHUB_RUN_ID}-${GITHUB_RUN_ATTEMPT}-${VERIFY_MODE}"
          mkdir "$root"
          mkdir "$root/tmp" "$root/device"
          git clone --no-hardlinks --no-checkout "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE" "$root/build"
          git -C "$root/build" checkout --detach "$(git rev-parse HEAD)"
          git -C "$root/build" remote set-url origin "https://github.com/${GITHUB_REPOSITORY}.git"
          if git show-ref --verify --quiet refs/remotes/origin/main; then
            git -C "$root/build" fetch "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE" refs/remotes/origin/main:refs/remotes/origin/main
          fi
          git -C "$root/build" for-each-ref --format='%(refname)' 'refs/remotes/origin/**' | while IFS= read -r ref; do
            if [ "$ref" != refs/remotes/origin/main ]; then
              git -C "$root/build" update-ref -d "$ref"
            fi
          done
          git -C "$root/build" reflog expire --expire=now --all
          git -C "$root/build" gc --prune=now --quiet
          pnpm --dir "$root/build" install --offline --frozen-lockfile --ignore-scripts
          python3 "$root/build/scripts/ci/p1-evidence.py" \
            --repo "$root/build" --evidence "$root/evidence" \
            --tmp "$root/tmp" --device "$root/device" \
            --node-bin "$(dirname "$(command -v node)")" --mode "$VERIFY_MODE"

      - name: Retain complete P1 evidence even on failure
        if: always()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@ea165f8d65b6e75b540449e92b4886f43607fa02 # v4.6.2
        with:
          name: ${{ env.VERIFY_MODE }}-evidence-${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha || github.sha }}-${{ github.run_attempt }}
          path: ${{ runner.temp }}/einzbern-p1-${{ github.run_id }}-${{ github.run_attempt }}-${{ matrix.mode }}/evidence/
          if-no-files-found: error
          retention-days: 14
          overwrite: false

      # Core and Portal have independent checkouts, outputs, HOME, device and TMPDIR.
      # The checks shard owns archive -> full-history privacy, wiring and package smoke.
      # S6 remains in tests/s6-lessons.test.mjs, executed once by the core roster.

      # TCRN-CROSS-STORY-481 (TCRN-CROSS-SUB-331): a device installs the release archive, not this
      # checkout. The archive is packed from a fresh build, checked against its .sha256 and unpacked
      # under the runner's temporary directory, where no node_modules and no dist/build lie on any
      # parent path, and the engine it carries runs with Node.js alone: its command catalog, then a
      # temporary library created and read back by status. The commands run from a temporary
      # directory with a temporary HOME and device directory, so no file of the checkout can stand
      # in for one the archive must carry. Last in the job, so it hides none of the steps above.
      - name: Smoke the release archive unpacked without node_modules
        if: env.VERIFY_MODE == 'p1-checks'
        working-directory: ${{ runner.temp }}/einzbern-p1-${{ github.run_id }}-${{ github.run_attempt }}-${{ matrix.mode }}/build
        run: |
          build_root="$PWD"
          version="$(node -p 'JSON.parse(require("node:fs").readFileSync("package.json", "utf8")).version')"
          smoke="$RUNNER_TEMP/einzbern-release-smoke"
          mkdir -p "$smoke/unpacked" "$smoke/home" "$smoke/work"
          mkdir "$smoke/evidence"
          git rev-parse HEAD > "$smoke/evidence/source-head.txt"
          pnpm run pack:release --out "$smoke/release" > "$smoke/evidence/pack.stdout"
          archive="$smoke/release/einzbern-$version.tar.gz"
          test "$(cut -d ' ' -f 1 "$archive.sha256")" = "$(sha256sum "$archive" | cut -d ' ' -f 1)"
          tar -xzf "$archive" -C "$smoke/unpacked"
          cp "$archive" "$archive.sha256" "$smoke/evidence/"
          cp "$smoke/unpacked/einzbern-$version/manifest.json" "$smoke/evidence/manifest.json"
          test ! -e "$smoke/unpacked/einzbern-$version/node_modules"
          engine="$smoke/unpacked/einzbern-$version/scripts/einzbern.mjs"
          cd "$smoke/evidence"
          export HOME="$smoke/home" EINZBERN_HOME="$smoke/home/.einzbern"
          node "$engine" commands > commands.json
          node "$engine" init --workspace "$smoke/library" --at "$(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ)" > init.json
          node "$engine" status --workspace "$smoke/library" > status.json
          # JavaScript template expressions must reach Node without shell expansion.
          # shellcheck disable=SC2016
          node --input-type=module -e '
            import assert from "node:assert/strict";
            import { readFileSync } from "node:fs";
            const read = (file) => JSON.parse(readFileSync(file, "utf8"));
            const version = process.argv[1];
            const catalog = read("commands.json");
            assert.equal(catalog.reasonCode, "CLI_CATALOG_READY");
            const verbs = catalog.commands.map((entry) => entry.name);
            for (const verb of ["init", "status", "engine-update", "skill-render"]) assert.ok(verbs.includes(verb), verb);
            const created = read("init.json");
            assert.equal(created.reasonCode, "LIBRARY_CREATED");
            const status = read("status.json");
            assert.equal(status.reasonCode, "WORKSPACE_COMMAND_COMPLETED");
            assert.equal(status.workspaceId, created.libraryId);
            assert.equal(status.engineVersion, version);
            console.log(`einzbern-${version} unpacked alone: ${verbs.length} commands, library ${created.libraryId} created and read`);
          ' "$version"
          # Exercise the actual installer and installed launcher in an isolated device home.
          node "$build_root/skill/mana-orchestrate/scripts/install.mjs" --archive "$archive" --home "$EINZBERN_HOME" > install.json
          installed="$EINZBERN_HOME/engine/einzbern.mjs"
          mkdir -p "$smoke/installed-project"
          at="$(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ)"
          node "$installed" setup --mode fresh --project "$smoke/installed-project" --artifacts "$smoke/installed-library" --cloud false --language en --navigation false --at "$at" > setup-plan.json
          node "$installed" setup --mode fresh --project "$smoke/installed-project" --artifacts "$smoke/installed-library" --cloud false --language en --navigation false --at "$at" --yes true > setup-applied.json
          node "$installed" doctor --project "$smoke/installed-project" > doctor.json
          node --input-type=module -e '
            import assert from "node:assert/strict";
            import { readFileSync } from "node:fs";
            const read = (file) => JSON.parse(readFileSync(file, "utf8"));
            assert.equal(read("install.json").reasonCode, "INSTALL_ENGINE_READY");
            const plan = read("setup-plan.json");
            assert.equal(plan.reasonCode, "SETUP_PLAN_READY");
            assert.deepEqual(plan.blockers, []);
            const applied = read("setup-applied.json");
            assert.equal(applied.reasonCode, "SETUP_APPLIED");
            assert.ok(applied.selfCheck.checks.every((check) => check.ok));
            const doctor = read("doctor.json");
            assert.equal(doctor.reasonCode, "DOCTOR_READY");
            assert.equal(doctor.checks.length, 8);
            assert.equal(doctor.ok, true, JSON.stringify(doctor.checks));
            console.log("Installed archive: setup plan/applied and doctor 8/8 verified");
          '

      - name: Retain curated package and isolated install evidence
        if: always() && env.VERIFY_MODE == 'p1-checks'
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@ea165f8d65b6e75b540449e92b4886f43607fa02 # v4.6.2
        with:
          name: package-smoke-${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha || github.sha }}-${{ github.run_attempt }}

    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04

    steps:

        uses: actions/checkout@9c091bb21b7c1c1d1991bb908d89e4e9dddfe3e0 # v7.0.0
        with:
          persist-credentials: false
          ref: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha || github.sha }}
      - name: Install pinned Node
        uses: actions/setup-node@949feb2413d6458794dcd2491c4babbbce0c15c1 # v7.1.0
        with:
          node-version: 24.16.0
      - name: Download this run's verification evidence
        uses: actions/download-artifact@d3f86a106a0bac45b974a628896c90dbdf5c8093 # v4.3.0
        with:
          pattern: '*-evidence-${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha || github.sha }}-${{ github.run_attempt }}'
          path: ${{ runner.temp }}/verification-evidence
      - name: Require complete same-SHA passing evidence
        env:
          VERIFY_MODE: ${{ github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch' && inputs.mode || 'p1' }}
          EXPECTED_SHA: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha || github.sha }}
          JOB_RESULT: ${{ needs.p1.result }}
        run: |
          python3 scripts/ci/aggregate-evidence.py \
            --artifacts "$RUNNER_TEMP/verification-evidence" --mode "$VERIFY_MODE" \
            --sha "$EXPECTED_SHA" --run-id "$GITHUB_RUN_ID" \
            --attempt "$GITHUB_RUN_ATTEMPT" --job-result "$JOB_RESULT"

        uses: actions/setup-node@949feb2413d6458794dcd2491c4babbbce0c15c1 # v7.1.0
        with:
          node-version: 24.16.0
      - name: Download this run's verification evidence
        uses: actions/download-artifact@9000827ccba6bdab643e8b6fd33ac0654aef8333 # v8.0.2
        with:
          pattern: '*-evidence-${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha || github.sha }}-${{ github.run_attempt }}'
          path: ${{ runner.temp }}/verification-evidence
      - name: Require complete same-SHA passing evidence
        env:
          VERIFY_MODE: ${{ github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch' && inputs.mode || 'p1' }}
          EXPECTED_SHA: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha || github.sha }}
          JOB_RESULT: ${{ needs.p1.result }}
        run: |
          python3 scripts/ci/aggregate-evidence.py \
            --artifacts "$RUNNER_TEMP/verification-evidence" --mode "$VERIFY_MODE" \
            --sha "$EXPECTED_SHA" --run-id "$GITHUB_RUN_ID" \
            --attempt "$GITHUB_RUN_ATTEMPT" --job-result "$JOB_RESULT"
